children: On September 2, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that it had regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after a 1-for-50 reverse stock split on August 18, 2026 led to the closing bid price being at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (August 19–September 1, 2026). The company had initially received a deficiency notice on September 11, 2025 and was granted compliance periods through September 7, 2026. Nasdaq confirmed the matter is now closed.
